reason: ShareBERT constructs encoder transformations by sharing embedding parameters with hidden layers, with embedding factorization/virtual embeddings variants. AAAI full text reports GLUE results: ShareBERT Small uses 5.0M parameters (21.9x fewer) and reaches 95.5% of BERT Base average score; Base/Large trade parameter count for accuracy. It also evaluates translation and image captioning. This is model-size compression for encoder PLMs, but not autoregressive LLM inference/serving; retained as borderline adjacent compression evidence.
title: ShareBERT: Embeddings Are Capable of Learning Hidden Layers
